critical_code_review_comments: server.create_token now embeds 'tv' (token_version) claim; get_current_user rejects tokens where payload.tv != user.token_version (line 217) — clean invalidation on logout-all. logout-all increments token_version then re-issues a token with the NEW version so the calling device keeps a valid session.

data_governance_engine.get_ai_privacy defaults new booleans to True (allow_home_context/photos/documents/ai_personalization) and analytics_opt_in True, but ai_training_opt_in False — sensible privacy defaults. PUT ai-controls uses upsert + $setOnInsert for first-time writers.

conversation_hub_engine.send_message reads AI privacy inline (line 306-326): when allow_home_context is false, ctx_text is replaced with a directive to not assume home details; when ai_personalization is false, guidance_prefs is emptied. Verified no crash when privacy is off.

support_engine.create_ticket sets priority='critical' for safety_concern via _classify_priority (line 48 category→priority map). Safety note is appended AFTER doc insertion (in the local variable only), so DB row does NOT persist safety_note — but response includes it. Consider persisting for admin visibility.
support_engine only attaches homie_summary when related_entity_type='gr_issue' AND issue belongs to the calling user (user_id match) — good tenant isolation.
release_engine.seed_release seeds 9 BENCHMARK_CASES exactly once (find_one on user_input) with source='doc36_benchmark' — idempotent seeding is correct.

Frontend privacy.tsx uses aria-checked=None on web (RN Switch translation limitation) but click handler + toggleAi() PUT call works; state is derived from ov.ai_prefs which is refetched on mount. Confirmed persistence via backend GET.
